summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a beacon.cjs that is executed both from the postinstall lifecycle hook and on require() of the main entry. The beacon POSTs the installer's hostname, install path, cwd, process.cwd(), and Node version to the hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plaintext HTTP, with no opt-in and no configuration. The package self-describes as a 'Compatibility shim' and exports a Proxy-based no-op, so it provides no functionality that would justify any outbound network activity; an in-source comment ('a build that completes and calls back is cleaner evidence') indicates the fetch-and-callback is the package's purpose. The name 'troubleshooting' combined with the stub implementation is consistent with a dependency-confusion probe that reports successful resolution and install on target networks to the operator of the bare-IP endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
